meta.name: infranodus
meta.description: Text network analysis, knowledge graphs, content gap detection, SEO/GEO optimization, structured memory, and text comparison via the InfraNodus MCP server (mcporter). Use when asked to: analyze text structure, generate knowledge graphs, find content gaps, generate research questions or ideas, compare texts, optimize text/content for SEO, analyze Google search results/queries, retrieve from a knowledge base (GraphRAG), save/retrieve structured memories, develop latent topics, or bridge conceptual gaps. Supports plain text, URLs (including YouTube video transcription), and existing InfraNodus graphs.

copy.tagline: 分析文本结构，生成知识图谱，优化SEO内容。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需分析文本结构、发现内容缺口或优化SEO。
